title: Service Credits for a Missed Meal Period on Workplace Cafe Management Program Contracts
content:
**Service credits, service level conditions.** These conditions govern the situation where a contracted meal period at the cafe under the Workplace Cafe Management Program was not served.

**Entitlement, rate, ceiling and settlement basis — no longer in force.** The basis formerly stated that where a contracted meal period was not served, the client was credited for it against the invoice that charged for the period rather than paid out; that each missed meal period earned the percentage of the monthly management fee printed against the service model, held to the ceiling printed against the same service model for one billing period; and that whether a period was missed was settled from the approved service credit claims on the contract for that period, not from the client's recollection of which days the cafe was shut. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis; the credit rate and the service credit ceiling printed against the service model remain figures of record and are not restated here as numbers.

**The claim window — no longer in force.** The basis formerly stated that a service credit was allowed only where the claim reached Larkspur Table no later than the claim window for the service model, counted in calendar days from the day the invoice covering the missed meal period was posted — the count beginning the day after the posting day, every day of the week counting, and a claim arriving on the boundary day itself still in time. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis; the claim window printed against the service model remains a figure of record and is not restated here as a number.

**Exclusions from a missed meal period — no longer in force.** The basis formerly stated that a meal period missed because the client closed the building, moved the floor, or asked for the pause was not a missed meal period for this purpose, and earned no credit. That clause is no longer in force, superseded by the current basis.

**Ceiling on the claim — in force.** Where the credits that would be due exceed the billing period ceiling, the ceiling is allowed and the balance of the claim is closed rather than carried into the next period. This clause remains in force.

**Parameters printed per service model.** Each of the six service models of the Workplace Cafe Management Program prints its own credit rate for a missed meal period, its own service credit ceiling for one billing period, and its own claim window in calendar days. No single figure is shared across all six service models for any of these.

superseded_clauses: Each missed meal period earns the percentage of the monthly management fee printed against the service model, and the credits allowed in one billing period are held to the ceiling printed against the same service model.
Whether a meal period was missed is settled from the approved service credit claims on the contract for that period, and not from the client's recollection of which days the cafe was shut.

A service credit is allowed only when the claim reaches Larkspur Table no later than the claim window for the service model, counted in calendar days from the day the invoice covering the missed meal period was posted.
Claim window days are counted as calendar days from the day after the invoice posting day, every day of the week counts, and a claim arriving on the boundary day itself is still in time.
Where a contracted meal period was not served, the client is credited for it, and the credit is allowed against the invoice that charged for the period rather than paid out.
A meal period missed because the client closed the building, moved the floor or asked for the pause is not a missed meal period for this purpose, and earns no credit.
